summary_md:
# 94. Rutger-rabatten i Logistea

**Feed**: veckans-trade  
**Published**: 2026-10-28  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The host recaps a volatile reporting period. Cybersecurity is the hot theme: MSAB fell after its XRY Pro software leaked onto Telegram, and Yubico spiked on US hype that he sees as speculation rather than fundamentals. He criticises retail 'dip buying' in Prisjakt's IPO and in Volvo Cars, and lists the worst Swedish CEOs (Dometic, Pricer, Bonava, EQL Pharma). He stays bullish long-term on property stocks such as Castellum, Logistea and Balder, and a Pareto analyst pitches Camurus ahead of a key study readout.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 MSAB-B — Micro Systemation | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

XRY Pro leaked to Telegram, stock -10%, CFO left. Price nearly doubled, so the host says wait.

#### Reasoning

Host liked the turnaround (two positive profit warnings, new CEO, laptop expansion). But the software leak through a hacked customer, the unexplained CFO exit and a roughly doubled price take away the easy upside. He would not buy the dip right now.

#### Sell Triggers

- further leaks or customer security failures
- more management departures

> *"så hade jag sagt Avvakta! Det är inte öppet mål i microsystemation längre tycker jag."*

---

### ⛔ YUBICO — Yubico | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Rally of 20%+ driven by a US cybersecurity tweet. Host sees a badly managed company and is unconvinced ahead of the report in about 8 days.

#### Reasoning

Host says the move is hype-driven (Armfelt retweet, US flows), not fundamental. Management's words have contradicted reality. He suggests scrutinising the upcoming report, especially guidance on demand for keys, before believing the move.

#### Sell Triggers

- report shows strong guidance and demand inflows

> *"I grund och botten så är det här ett jättedåligt skött bolag."*

---

### ⛔ VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Revenue -23%, stock -30%, crowded retail dip buying. Host doubts the product quality.

#### Reasoning

Host argues that the best trades are in forgotten stocks with forced sellers. A crowded retail dip-buy in a widely known bad story is unlikely to pay off within 6-12 months, and Volvo Cars' cars have lacked quality for years.

#### Sell Triggers

- clear revenue recovery
- stock becomes forgotten/unowned

> *"Om du och alla avanzianer samtidigt köper Volcar på minus 30% är sannolikheten att alla ni kommer sätta bort och göra en jättebra affär på 6-12 månader. Jag tror inte det."*

---

### 🟢 LOGI-B — Logistea | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Forced seller (Arnhult) gone after a SEK 700m block on report day. Strong report, stock +7.5% the next day.

#### Reasoning

With Rutger Arnhult's overhang removed, the 'Rutger discount' should shrink and the stock becomes a new short-term case. The host bought the block and took a 3-4% profit. He is also bullish on property stocks long-term.

#### Sell Triggers

- new large seller emerges
- property sector sentiment turns

> *"Att Logistea är ju på kort sikt ett nytt case. Och man har inte den här forcerade säljaren"*

---

### 🟢 CAST — Castellum | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Large discount to book value. About 60% of Wihlborgs sale proceeds goes to buybacks, and the host is still bullish on property stocks.

#### Reasoning

The CEO is doing something transformative by buying back shares at a discount instead of buying more property. The host says the risk-reward in property stocks is very good for long-term holders, though he does not expect 300% upside.

#### Sell Triggers

- buyback program abandoned
- rates/credit environment worsens

> *"Här bettar man faktiskt på någonting och jag är fortsatt bull till fastighetsbolagen."*

---

### 🟢 BALD-B — Balder | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Good report. Host is bullish on property for long-term holders and suggests holding Balder for two years.

#### Reasoning

Sector-level long-term bullishness on property stocks after strong reports. Mentioned as a two-year hold alongside Castellum and Eastnine.

#### Sell Triggers

- property sector reports deteriorate

> *"köp kanske Castellum och Balder och Eastnine och Altra på två år så blir det nog inte jättedåligt"*

---

### 🟢 EAST — Eastnine | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Good report. Included in the host's two-year property basket.

#### Reasoning

Same sector-level long-term property thesis as Balder.

#### Sell Triggers

- property sector reports deteriorate

> *"köp kanske Castellum och Balder och Eastnine och Altra på två år så blir det nog inte jättedåligt"*

---

### 🟢 CAMX — Camurus | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Pareto analyst Philip Wiberg (sponsor segment): top healthcare pick. GEP-NET superiority readout Q4/Q1 with limited downside.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion, not the host's. The base business is about SEK 3bn in sales with a 40% EBIT margin. CAM2029 is launched in the EU, with the US to follow. A positive GEP-NET readout could take most of the market (peak sales about 10x today's). Positioning is light before the readout, and the delay is likely a good sign.

#### Sell Triggers

- negative GEP-NET readout
- further readout delays
- US launch setback

> *"Ja, vi är positiva till Camurus. Det är ett av våra topics inom hälsosektorn."*

---

### ⛔ EQL — EQL Pharma | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Host calls the CEO the worst on the exchange and hopes the company falls to about SEK 100m. Reports in 7 days.

#### Reasoning

The host has a long-running grudge after a sneaked-out profit warning. He views management as very poor and openly expects the valuation to keep falling.

#### Sell Triggers

- strong report reversing the trend

> *"Så om jag får lägga till en MÖG7-vinnare så är det EQL Pharmas VD."*

---

### ⛔ DOM — Dometic | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

On the worst-CEO list. A +17% open on organic growth faded to a negative close, and the stock is down 70% since 2021.

#### Reasoning

Even a better quarter can't hold gains. The host sees a structurally weak business and finds none of the listed companies interesting.

#### Sell Triggers

- sustained organic growth with price holding

> *"Så det spelar ingen roll om man får upp den organiska tillväxten lite. För Dometic är Dometic."*

---

### ⛔ PRIC-B — Pricer | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

On the worst-CEO list. Host calls it a long-term value trap.

#### Reasoning

Persistent underperformance and management criticism. Host sees no interest in the company.

#### Sell Triggers

- management change with improved execution

> *"Pricer har varit en värdefälla sedan jag gick i blöja i princip."*

---

### ⛔ SBB-B — SBB | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Board rejected the D-share dividend and the host shorted it briefly. Among the most shorted stocks for six years; he questions why anyone would own it.

#### Reasoning

Poor risk-reward and a long history of management over-promising. The host says owners waste energy on it and that time is better spent elsewhere.

#### Sell Triggers

- clear balance sheet resolution

> *"Det är en av de mest blankade aktierna och har varit det de senaste sex åren. Varför ska man in där och gröta?"*

---

### ⛔ INTRUM — Intrum | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Fell 40% on a write-down. The CFO bought SEK 0.5m, but host says no to buying the dip: everyone knows it is bad.

#### Reasoning

Crowded, well-known bad story, much like Volvo Cars. The CFO purchase eases fears of a rights issue, but the host did not act on it.

#### Sell Triggers

- no new rights issue and debt progress

> *"När Måns Möller skriver det så säger jag nej."*

---

### 🟠 ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Revenue missed, stock -8%. Host doubts that buying the dip is right given the data-center premium.

#### Reasoning

Atlas Copco, ABB and Alfa Laval were re-rated on data-center orders. If the US data-center story slows, dips are less forgiving.

#### Sell Triggers

- data-center order momentum slows

> *"Jag vet inte om det är helt rätt play, för den aktien har ju blivit som många andra."*

---
